crypto_headlines.title: Binance restores withdrawals after the $6.3B hack
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance restored USDC, USDT and ETH withdrawals on Ethereum and USDC, USDT and BNB withdrawals on BNB Smart Chain, after reopening BTC withdrawals first. It says about 95% of the stolen funds have been covered.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance puts 50% of its SAFU fund toward hack losses
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Yi He, Binance is allocating half of its SAFU emergency fund to cover the hack losses and keeping the other half in reserve.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance hacker swaps stolen SOL for BTC through Relay
crypto_headlines.summary: The hacker moved 486,970 SOL worth $46.4M in one hour and is swapping it for BTC through Relay Protocol.

crypto_headlines.title: Trump says he is not concerned about the Binance hack
crypto_headlines.summary: Asked about possible North Korean links, President Trump said he is not concerned about the $6.3B hack and that the US will talk to North Korea about it.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot ETH ETFs log a record 23 straight days of outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Glassnode, US spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded 23 consecutive trading sessions of net outflows, their longest streak since launch.

crypto_headlines.title: China's Communist Party calls for a crypto corruption crackdown
crypto_headlines.summary: A party resolution calls for combating corruption carried out through the internet, virtual currency, cross-border capital and blockchain.

doginal_news.title: Happy Howl-o-ween from the official account
doginal_news.summary: The official Doginal Dogs account marked Halloween: Doginal Dogs are built different, down to the bone.

doginal_news.title: Two more rescued dogs heading home
doginal_news.summary: BradX reports JonXDG says another wallet verified ownership of 2 rescued Doginal Dogs. The marketplace is still paused with zero listings and no sale since #6717 at 85k DOGE on Oct 24.

doginal_news.title: Bark: the account is a vessel for the community
doginal_news.summary: A clip from the Great Reset Space has Bark explaining why Doginal Dogs isn't tied to one account or one person.

doginal_news.title: AGS slab sells on eBay for over $200
doginal_news.summary: And says his AGS-graded Legends slab sold on eBay for over $200, noting each DDLTCG booster box has 5 full arts.

doginal_news.title: Pyth leads prediction-market settlements
doginal_news.summary: A community tally counts 222,723 Kalshi and Polymarket contracts settled with Pyth data from Sep 28 to Oct 27, versus 93,862 for Chainlink.

doginal_news.title: Korean stocks get post-market hours on Pyth Pro
doginal_news.summary: SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, Hyundai Motor and Samsung Electro-Mechanics now have post-market pricing on Pyth Pro, 16:00 to 20:00 KST.

notes: No new posts from @DDLTCG or @PythNetwork in the last 24 hours; DDLTCG and Pyth items come from community accounts.
